Auravision.description: Beginning at 3rd level, an occult slayer can perceive magical auras within 60 feet as a free action. This functions identically to detect magic, except that the occult slayer can only discern the number of magical auras present, not any additional information about them.

Blank Thoughts.description: At 5th level, an occult slayer can enter a state of complete mental emptiness, rendering herself immune to all mind-affecting effects, including charms, compulsions, patterns, phantasms, and morale effects. She may activate or deactivate this ability as a free action.

Magical Defense.description: Through rigorous practice at resisting all forms of magic, an occult slayer gains a bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities. This bonus starts at +1 at 1st level, rises to +2 at 3rd level, and reaches +3 at 5th level.

Mind Over Magic.description: From 2nd level onward, an occult slayer can reflect a spell or spell-like ability that targets her back at its caster as a free action. This works like spell turning with a caster level equal to her occult slayer level + 5. She may use this ability once per day at 2nd level, increasing to twice per day at 4th level.

Nondetection Cloak.description: At 4th level, an occult slayer and all equipment she wears or carries become resistant to divination magic such as clairaudience/clairvoyance, locate object, and similar detection effects. She receives protection equivalent to nondetection (caster level equal to her occult slayer level), though this protection applies solely to herself and her gear.

Vicious Strike.description: Starting at 2nd level, when an occult slayer readies an attack action specifically to disrupt a spellcaster, she inflicts double damage on a successful hit.

Weapon Bond.description: An occult slayer selects a single weapon of at least masterwork quality to serve as the vessel for her power. Once chosen, she forges a supernatural link with that weapon, channeling her animosity toward spellcasters through it. Any successful strike she lands with this bonded weapon against a spellcaster or a creature possessing spell-like abilities deals an additional 1d6 points of damage. If the bonded weapon is lost or destroyed, she cannot deal the extra damage until she obtains and bonds with a new weapon of the same type, which must also be at least masterwork quality. Establishing a new bond requires one day of dedicated practice per character level, during which she can do little else and cannot adventure.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: Occult slayers gain proficiency with all simple weapons, all martial weapons, every type of armor, and all shields.
